8.5.1. iLock_Geography.geo_algorithms.element.containsBentSwitchLeg¶

iLock_Geography.geo_algorithms.element.containsBentSwitchLeg(nodeIndex)¶

Check if nodeIndex contains a bent switch leg.

In more detail, check if the node contains a switch which has its bent switch leg pointing in the same direction as the index.

Parameters:nodeIndex (NodeIndex) – The node index we are examining.
Return type:bool
Returns:True iff nodeIndex contains a bent switch leg.
